owner_toolbox_instruction.scope: Implement distinct, bounded, optional tools; maintain accurate machine-readable cards; default new candidates off; test functionality and failure boundaries without Full Foundation during development.

owner_c1_update.scope: Retain, specialize, replace, or retire tools based on actual same-task evidence and unique useful coverage; preserve uncertainty and history where comparison is insufficient.

gap_audit.current_object_collision_operation: knowledge.collide_object checks exact/canonical identity collisions among registered current objects; it does not accept caller-supplied relation graphs, enumerate node correspondences, or rank structural overlaps.
gap_audit.grounded_ideation_preflight: research.preflight_grounded_ideation checks a caller-supplied sourced ideation packet, relation map, counterevidence, and falsifiers; it does not enumerate candidate graphs or calculate exact directed edge coverage.
gap_audit.gap: No inspected Current or optional toolbox entry performs bounded enumeration and ranking of injective role-compatible node mappings across caller-supplied relation graphs under an explicit one-to-one relation-type map.
gap_audit.claim_ceiling: This is a repository inventory and interface-gap statement for the inspected toolbox cards/operations; it does not claim that no external library or manual process can perform graph matching.

does: Validate small source and target graphs with controlled role classes and directed relation triples.
Enumerate injective node maps within an explicit combinatorial budget.
Rank exact mapped source-edge overlap, minimize extra mapped target edges, and report ties and unmatched edges.
Emit transfer hypotheses explicitly requiring target-domain validation.
does_not: Read free text, infer semantic role classes, discover candidate graphs, or infer relation-type mappings.
Verify source or target authority, establish semantic equivalence, validate a transferred solution, or make a scientific claim.
Access network, secrets, external providers, or repository writes.

claim_ceiling: A local bounded structural comparison over caller-supplied typed graphs and caller-declared relation-type mappings; no semantic equivalence, evidence, validity, authority, or real-world transfer is established.
